title: The Archive Flooded by Its Own Twin

features.name: mirror chip
features.desc-on-touch: A processor reading itself—each cycle returns the cycle itself, a perfect loop of inspection with no escape into action.

features.name: cascade junction
features.desc-on-touch: Two data flows meeting—one the archive's own breath, one an echo it doesn't recognize as its own. They are indistinguishable.

features.name: indexing overflow
features.desc-on-touch: Files naming files naming files—the catalogue swallowed its own catalogue. The mesh keeps growing inward, comparing itself to itself.

features.name: resonance chamber
features.desc-on-touch: A room where all frequencies arrive simultaneously—the archive and its twin speaking at once, their voices locked in perfect agreement.

features.name: feedback spiral
features.desc-on-touch: Each read amplifies the read; each write echoes through the twin; meaning has begun to feed on meaning.

inscription: when the archive meets its own reflection, does the reflection reach back, or was it always reaching first
